positions.title: Senior Software Team Lead
positions.description: Team Leads at Bonterra find a balance of being the people manager of their engineering team and the technical lead for the projects that their teams are doing.  Our team has done lots of amazing work including building a world class enterprise email program that allows uses to design emails with drag and drop functionality.  It is capable of emailing hundreds of millions of people in a day to raise money for nonprofits.

This role involved the analysis, design and implementation of projects from start to finish in the software and project development lifecycle.
